title: AnyBlock JSON bundle index
description: One index.json at the root of a bundle describes the bundle as a whole: what the space is called, where a user lands after installing it, and what the sidebar shows. Everything else in a bundle describes a single object; this is the only document that describes the set.

$schema.description: Which of the format's three grammars this document follows. Optional, since `formatVersion` gates the version, but a reader dispatches on it and a URL naming another grammar is refused.

network_id.description: Optional opaque identifier of the exporting node's network, not validated. Import uses it to decide whether remote files can be recovered; an unrecognized value does not invalidate the bundle.

name.description: The space's name, applied on install.

description.description: One line on what the space is for. Author-facing and applied to the space where the client shows one.

icon.description: The space's icon, exactly the shape `icon` has on any object: an emoji, the object id of an image in the bundle, a raw content cid, a built-in icon name, or a bare colour.

entrypoint.description: The declared entry object's bundle-local id, used as the space homepage when `homepage` is absent. Declaring it does not insert or reorder sidebar widgets.

homepage.description: What opens on entering the space. Wins over `entrypoint`; if absent use `entrypoint`, then the first widget naming an object, then the installer's default. An explicit id is never replaced.

widgets.description: Sidebar widgets in their declared order. Navigation fields do not insert or reorder them. When `homepage` and `entrypoint` are both absent, the first widget naming an object is the fallback.

auto_widget_targets.description: The targets the client has already auto-added a widget for, so it does not re-add one the user deleted. Space state, not sidebar content. Written on export.

auto_widget_disabled.description: The user turned automatic widget creation off for this space. Written on export.

manifest.description: Where to find what a reader cannot reach by walking the documents: the property dictionary and the bytes behind each file document. The format defines no folder layout.

unresolved.description: What this bundle names and cannot answer for. Present only when there is something to report; absence says it reports nothing, never that every reference resolves.

properties.description: The property dictionary's path, relative to this file. It is properties.json at the bundle root unless the manifest names another path.

files.description: File object id to the blob's path, relative to this file. A populated map is the binding; `{}` is the export stating it carried no blobs; an absent member states nothing and reads the same way.

manifest.description: Where to find what a reader cannot reach by walking the documents: the property dictionary and the bytes behind each file document. Types are not located here; a type document is found by its id.

unresolved.description: The bundle's account of the names it uses and cannot explain: property keys nothing defines, and ids no document in the bundle carries.

properties.description: The stored property keys the bundle's documents reference and nothing could define, written verbatim. An export also gives each one a dictionary entry whose format is `unknown`.

targets.description: The ids this index names that no document in the bundle carries: an `entrypoint`, a `homepage`, a widget `target`, an image icon. A reserved listing never appears here.

deleted.description: The subset of `targets` the space deleted, each naming a tombstone in the source store. Every entry must also appear in `targets`, and none in `omitted`.

omitted.description: The subset of `targets` the space still holds that this export did not write, such as an archived or out-of-scope object. Every entry must also appear in `targets`, and none in `deleted`.

types.description: Types named by derived id that no type document carries and the source space never held. An object of one imports as a Page; a slot that only references it drops the entry instead.

widgetTarget.description: An object id from this bundle, or a reserved listing: `_favorite`, `_set`, `_collection`, `_all_objects`, `_recent` (edited), `_recent_open` (opened), `_chat`, `_bin`. Object ids never start with `_`.

layout.description: How the widget renders: `link` is a single row, `tree` expands children, `list` and `compact_list` show contents, `view` renders a type's or query's own view.

limit.description: How many entries a listing widget shows, ignored by `link`. The cap is the object schema's $defs/widgetListingLimit.

view_id.description: Which view in the target's primary dataview this widget shows. Must match the exported view id, including its target-local short label when compaction is enabled. Omit for the target's default view.

auto_added.description: The client added this widget automatically rather than the user placing it. Written on export, so a restored sidebar keeps behaving like the original.

card_style.description: How the widget's row renders, the link block's own member. Defaults to `text`.

icon_size.description: The icon size on the widget's card, the link block's own member. Defaults to `none`.

description.description: What the widget's card shows under the title, the link block's own member. Defaults to `none`.

properties.description: The property spellings shown on the widget's card. They resolve through the bundle's property dictionary, properties.json; there is no per-document legend here.
